transit.description: No script: hashes a package's files into its dependants' typecheck, test and build (the packages are source-only, so a change in one must re-run them)

typecheck.description: tsc over each program of the package (no emit); the packages' Vitest configs import tools/vitest, and the workerd programs read the Workers runtime types in tools/workers

test.description: Vitest; arguments after `--` (such as CI's --shard=N/3) reach every package's run and its cache key. The packages' Vitest configs import tools/vitest. Locally `pnpm test` (tools/test.sh) limits the packages that test at once and each Vitest's workers (the local test budget, docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): the variables below only change how many run at once, never a result, so they pass through to the task without entering its hash (CI also keeps Vitest's defaults)

build.description: The control panel's bundle (apps/web/dist), served by the Worker as its assets

//#typecheck:root.description: tsc over the deploy code at the root (tsconfig.infra.json) and the Worker modules it imports; the root task hashes the whole repository

//#lint:root.description: One oxlint (type-aware) and oxfmt --check run over the whole repository
